scope: Independent static read of frozen predecessor protection, target binding, explicit selection and UI; no live result conferred.
readFindings: History preparation requires a selected original operation and a separate confirmation. A new real click is required; no recovery starts at history inspection.

Recovery admission requires a fresh click binding on the same browser process, native window/tab, document, composer and original draft generation. A registered predecessor checkpoint and original artifact hash are required.

The page checks its original operation, successful input count, returned change, original invocation, and original membership or proved disappearance. A fresh/ambiguous page cannot reconstruct the witness.

The new attempt and predecessor/successor record are written together. Prepared input-free rollback may restore which operation is active. A predecessor already linked to a successor is guarded against new invocation ownership, late receipt writes and restart reconciliation.
The legacy build-59 observation resource is retained alongside 56/57/58. Reconciliation and a new input have distinct paths.
reviewLimits: Conservative site marker and card requirements may decline recovery on an unobserved layout. Static inspection alone gives no G4 or package PASS.
